_comment: A scripted operator session that reviews and approves an irreversible step.
The operator issues no commands: they looked at the intervention request --
which carries the screenshot, the proposed action and the reason -- decided
the commit was correct, and handed control back. That is the real semantics
of 'confirm', and it is why the resolution is `resumed` rather than
`completed_by_operator`: the automation performs the step, with a human
Used to make discovery reproducible in CI and when regenerating evidence.
Interactively you would use --operator console, --operator web, or
notes: Operator reviewed the irreversible sub-account commit and authorised it.
